task: Emesis (vomiting) reflex -- multi-input triggering + the brainstem central pattern generator (CPG). Model the emetic CPG (dorsal vagal complex: area postrema/CTZ + NTS) as a convergence of 4 decorrelated afferent pathways with distinct receptor pharmacology: (1) area postrema/chemoreceptor trigger zone (CTZ, outside the BBB, D2/5-HT3/NK1, blood-borne emetics); (2) vagal GI afferents (5-HT3, enterochromaffin-cell serotonin release, chemo/irritation); (3) vestibular (H1/muscarinic, motion sickness); (4) higher CNS/anticipatory. FALSIFIER (symmetric): reproduce the input-specific antiemetic efficacy double-dissociation -- 5-HT3 antagonists (ondansetron) block chemo/vagal-triggered emesis but NOT motion sickness; H1/anticholinergics (scopolamine) block motion but not chemo -- forcing a 'single universal antiemetic receptor/pathway' adversary to its strongest fair form and showing it fails. Area-postrema-ablation dissociation (Borison & Wang classic) must abolish blood-borne/apomorphine emesis while sparing vagal/GI and motion emesis. Cisplatin biphasic pharmacology (acute 5-HT3-dominant + delayed NK1/substance-P-dominant, aprepitant) as a decorrelated temporal anchor.
confidence_tier: MIXED, disclosed per-leg. Core double-dissociation (Section 4a of the doc): human-RCT-anchored for 3/4 matrix cells (Cubeddu 1990 n=28; Navari 1999 n=159; Stott 1989's own hyoscine arm), consensus-tier for the 4th (scopolamine-vs-chemo null, no clean primary-agent RCT found this session). Area-postrema ablation: animal-ablation-anchored, 2 independent species-era/manipulations 35 years apart (Wang & Borison 1952 classic lesion; Harding et al 1987 vascular interruption + i.c.v./i.v. route threshold, dog). Cisplatin biphasic timing+pharmacology: human-RCT-anchored, 2 independent trials 14 years apart (Kris 1985 n=86 timing-only, pre-5-HT3/NK1 era; Navari 1999 n=159 receptor-specific). The Part-A toy convergence model (receptor-space geometry, rank-1 adversary, void-floor crosstalk-severity sweep) is model-internal/structural-sufficiency tier throughout -- it demonstrates the mechanism is CAPABLE of the observed pattern; it is not an independent measurement and Part B (the real-data falsifier) does not depend on its specific weight choices.
